preconditions.expression: all(c in '47' for c in N)
preconditions.description: N contains only the digits '4' and '7'
The length of N is between 1 and 49 inclusive

postconditions.description: The return value is an integer
The return value is a positive integer

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(2**i for i in range(len(N))) + int(N.replace('7', '1'), 2)
postconditions.description: The return value is the position of N in the series of numbers composed of only digits 4 and 7
